taxonomyNote: NatureServe notes I. nebulifer was formerly included in Bufo valliceps and separated from I. valliceps by mtDNA work (Mulcahy and Mendelson 2000); NatureServe uses Incilius rather than Bufo.
behavior: Migrates between breeding and nonbreeding habitats.
Lays eggs in spring or summer in pools, including roadside and irrigation ditches; in Texas, calling lasted 7-29 nights (mean 15.4) with choruses of 2-65 males.
habitat: Coastal prairies, barrier beaches, towns and a variety of other habitats; eggs and larvae develop in pools including roadside and irrigation ditches.
range: Southern Arkansas, southern Mississippi, Louisiana and central Texas in the United States, south to Veracruz, Mexico.
